{{Quote|I am now in the process of loading a comprehensive package of unlimited-class total-combat maneuvers, the use of many of which constitutes a felony on most civilized worlds.|C-3PO bluffs while coming to the aid of Allana Solo in Monarg's Mechanic Works|<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
This '''skirmish''' took place in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] when [[Monarg]] attempted steal [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining]] the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in his shop, [[Monarg's Mechanic Works]]. [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], whose grandparents, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]], were attending a [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], decided to try and rescue R2-D2, but was met with hostilities from Monarg. After a short skirmish with Monarg, Allana fled the man's shop with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], R2-D2, and her pet [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], [[Anji]]. They went back aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], and Allana took off in the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] it away and accidentally causing severe damage to the fence surrounding the [[Dathomir Spaceport|spaceport]].
